name: Oujo Choukyou ~Kanashiku Saezuru Kotori~
original_name: 王女調教　～悲しくさえずる小鳥～
source:
You play the emperor of the empire, bending to have a royal marriage with Nasha, a queen of the defeated nation. His true purpose is to possess her as a sex slave of his own. Give her sexual training to the pretty princess in the name of training for married life.
